title: Missing Latvians believed to have been in China, not Nepal
summary_full: China has officially confirmed that all 33 missing Latvian nationals were believed to be in Tibet at the time of the recent catastrophic floods and had not crossed the border back to Nepal, Edīte Medne, Director of the Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, confirmed on Wednesday.
